requirement:
修复订票和取消订单流程中发送通知邮件的异常。
用户反馈下单后收不到确认邮件，取消订单后也收不到通知。
经排查是邮件发送接口调用异常，需要检查相关服务的通知调用逻辑。

details.name: ts-notification-service
details.rationale: Central service for sending notifications/emails; the email sending exception likely originates or is fixed here.

details.name: ts-cancel-service
details.rationale: Handles cancellation flow and has recent commits about fixing email exceptions, likely calls notification service.

details.name: ts-preserve-other-service
details.rationale: Related to preserve flow and has recent commits about fixing email exceptions, may share notification logic.

details.name: ts-order-service
details.rationale: Order service interacts with preserve and cancel flows; may need changes if notification calls are integrated.

details.name: ts-order-other-service
details.rationale: Similar to order service, may be involved in order-related notification calls.

details.name: ts-gateway-service
details.rationale: Gateway routes requests to services; if notification endpoints are changed, routing may need updates.
